changelog: NEW: Refresh screen shows a live 'Connecting to Gcore CDN…' indicator with the Gcore logo, then flips to 'Connected to Gcore CDN' with a green status dot as soon as the device confirms a successful round-trip to the CDN. Customers see real proof their stream is delivered through enterprise-grade infrastructure.
Splash screen reverted to its previous look — the Gcore trust signal lives on the refresh screen instead.
